name: Terran, placed for play
note: Round 9: round 8's console with things where a player looks for them and the buttons StarCraft 1 needs. The resources are back at the top right, in a small plate of round 8's materials (minerals, gas, and supply in the lit cell), and their alerts ring there. The bar over the minimap holds 1.17's buttons and APM: Diplomacy (Terrain in single player, View Players in a replay, one place as 1.17 shares it), Messaging, and APM in the lit cell beside the clock. A button the game hides leaves its cell unlit. The Game Menu (F10) is the portrait's chevron tab, on the console's top edge over the portrait as in 1.17. SC2's idle-worker and army buttons, with their counts, are a tab on the minimap block's top edge at its left end. The MENU / HELP / SOCIAL panel is gone. At Width 16:9 (round 13) the console keeps to a 16:9 screen's width in the middle of a wider one, and the centre's rail and foot run on past the blocks to the screen's edges. Built by huds/kits/build-r9.mjs on round 8's pieces. Hyperion's copy: no game timer in the skin; the time slot and its cell are left out. No flash on a new selection. Hyperion's copy: the selection's grid shows at most 8 columns, 24 units a page as StarCraft II's (the user, 2026-10-23).

options.label: Width
options.help: 16:9 keeps the console as wide as a 16:9 screen's, in the middle of a wider one, so the minimap and the command card stay where your hands know them; past it the console's rail and foot run on to the edges. On a 16:9 screen or a narrower one the two are the same.

values.label: Full screen
values.help: The HUD runs the width of the screen.
The HUD keeps to the middle of a wider screen, as wide as a 16:9 screen's.
